title: Verify deferred activation latch across post-mount render preference changes
outcome: Adjudicated Claude7558 Medium from final scroll review. Claimed delayed collapse of warm restored cards is not supported by current lifecycle: inactive virtualized list unmounts cards; restored true preference is present at remount and initializes isActivated=true. Do not record that specific scenario as proven. Separately DeferredHeavyContent does not latch a false->true preference transition after mount, unlike its documented monotonic-visible expectation; test same mounted wrapper false->true->false with viewport activation disabled, and extend detached warm-return coverage past measuring timers/frames. Establish whether reachable product use needs latching before modifying behavior. Preserve expansion measurement and direct-scroll authority. No executed reproduction yet; current full gate ee232913 PASS is not proof of this additional contract.
